My associates and I are in the process of compiling a series of documents pertaining to the Harbingers of a great and wonderful change that is imminent upon the people of this world. However, in order to complete the cycle, we need a member of Foundation staff who would be willing and able to facilitate the arrival of our savior. Do you know of any Foundation staff that would be willing to sacrifice themselves to help the human race as a whole?

Serious offers only. Non-smokers, please.
